title: Clock machine diagonal specification
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ and $s$ be finite Boolean words. If $K$ halts on input $x$ with output $s$ after exactly $t_K$ steps, then the clock machine built from $K$ and $W$ halts on input $x$, outputs the one-symbol word whose value is the negation of the proposition that $W$ halts on $x$ within exactly the number of steps represented by $s$ and outputs the one-symbol word containing true, and does so after exactly $t_K+4|s|+|x|+4\,\operatorname{ctrVal}(s)+6$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $K$ and $W$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
$K$ halts on input $x$ with output $s$ after exactly $t_K$ steps
